# stalwart_mta_virtual_queue (Data Source)

Defines a virtual queue for organizing outbound message delivery.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Identifier of the object. Set either `id` or `name`.
- `name` (String) Unique identifier for the queue, max 8 characters

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) A short description of the queue, which can be used to identify it in the list of queues
- `threads_per_node` (Number) Maximum number of threads to use for delivery on each node in the cluster
